title: Where Should the Code Go? Locating Foundation-Model Errors in Bitemporal Inventory Simulation: code, data and all model requests and responses
description: Code, seeded environment, protocols, independent audits and all 36,672 scored model requests and responses for the paper "Where Should the Code Go? Locating Foundation-Model Errors in Bitemporal Inventory Simulation" (NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Temporal Systems, poster). Code is MIT licensed; data, model outputs, protocols and paper text are CC BY 4.0. FreshRetailNet-50K profiles are derived from Dingdong-Inc / Wang et al. (2025) under CC BY 4.0.
